description: Generating Recurrent Waste Collection Problem Instances Inspired by the 8th DIMACS Implementation Challenge. is published by Tarek Boufar. The code generates recurrent waste-routing benchmarks from DIMACS travelling-salesperson instances. Its stated coverage is Synthetic network instances. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Generated benchmarks do not describe an actual waste-service territory. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
